identity: integral (d_y^3 K) pi dy = - integral (d_y^2 K)(d_y log pi) pi dy
scope: This is the general derivative-transfer identity used by the method. The paper's surrounding stochastic estimates are audited by source anchors and are not inferred from the Gaussian quadrature.
